_about: Fixes for breaks in the admin friction log. Live ticks every entry of this kind whose text contains match and that happened before at (ms). Add one line per shipped fix.

fixes.note: Every countdown chip opens the grid check
Trophy on a player card opens the champions sheet
Avatar on a player card opens your avatar editor or the season head to head
Stat bars on a player card open the league ranking for that stat
Stat bars on a player card open the league ranking for that stat
Avatar is a button now; the tap came seconds before that fix went live
A pick's logo in All Picks opens that game's info
Last five chips open that game's gamecast
Last five chips open that game's gamecast
The preview expands to the full write-up on tap
Tiebreaker line on a player card opens the tiebreaker game once it has kicked off
Re-tapping the tab you're on, already at the top, now refreshes and shows 'Up to date' instead of doing nothing
A dropped /auth call keeps the last known login mode, retries once in the background and never waits over 6s
/avatars waits 5s at most, retries once, keeps saved avatars; the roster no longer waits on it
Names in the Gamecast room open that player's card
Logo taps only count toward the admin prompt when already at the top, so tapping to scroll up never opens it
Steps in the How chance to win works explainer are reading, not controls; no longer logged as dead taps
Trivia boards wait 5s at most, retry once, and show the last good board on a miss; the screen never waits on them
/weeks waits 6s at most and retries once; the saved weeks show meanwhile and the screen never waits on it. Live now closes a multi-call blip from one phone as one event
Already covered (short try, cool-down, saved copy served). The once-per-6h note now holds across all Worker instances via KV, and Live no longer raises it as an action

Score cards and pick-card teams take touch-action: manipulation, so quick taps open the game sheet at once on iOS; a rage tap now needs all three taps on the same element (taps landing on the sheet a tap opened no longer count)
ESPN refusing the phone (Firefox calls it Cross-Origin Request Blocked) is covered by the Worker's /live copy; the scoreboard read is now logged only when that fallback fails too
Game news past 30 minutes old answers from the saved copy at once and refreshes in the background, instead of waiting 4 to 5s on the feeds

The model refused a chat whose tool results outnumbered the kept calls (10 per-game picks calls); the Worker now keeps 12 and drops orphaned results, and 'rarest' answers unique-pick questions in one call
Same as the app side: orphaned tool results made the model API refuse the chat; fixed in the Worker
Both score sources down is the phone's signal; the app now waits 3s and tries the Worker again, and logs only if that fails too while online and on screen
The scheduled job (every 2h, hourly Saturday) now fetches news for every unfinished game ahead of time, so a game's first open no longer waits on the feeds
